(4) Criterion-3 table: rows 2 and 3 hinge on whether the main claim holds 'at every other value in the sweep', which cannot be checked when figures (Fig. 5) are unavailable; I relied on the paper's text (effect rises over layers 19-28) and chose MAJOR. This is a judgement call the skill leaves ambiguous. (5) Pool-position bands (55-69 maps to scores 55-61) sit awkwardly with 'Overall 4 needs pool >= 65 and dimension scores mostly >= 60'; R3/R4 sit at the top of or above the script's band for their pool position without a warning. (6) Phase 1.6 report check and all five reviewers share one context, so independence is nominal.
